label: Printful events
description: Signature-verified inbound Printful webhook envelopes. The webhook route only persists here and returns 200; all enrichment happens off the created event.

dedupe_key.description: type + the order or shipment id + occurred_at. Unique — Printful retries at 1, 4, 16, 64, 256 and 1024 minutes and sends no delivery id, so this is how a replay is dropped

occurred_at.description: occurred_at from the Printful envelope, not receipt time

store_id.description: Printful store the event came from

retries.description: Delivery attempt count reported by Printful

data.description: Verified event payload, stored verbatim so an event can be replayed after a handler fix

processed.description: Set once the handler finished. Unprocessed rows are what an operator replays

process_error.description: Why the handler could not process this event

types.description: A verified Printful event was received and is ready to handle
